variables.name: a
variables.meaning: resolved axes used to project data-space geometry

variables.name: k
variables.meaning: emitted visible primitives and polyline vertices

contract.proof: Canvas2D visits each packed data-space primitive once, projects it through its two retained axis scales, and retains no geometry copy.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every visible primitive has a distinct color and both axes use non-identity ranges.

fullScan.rationale: Rasterizing one invalidated frame must consume every emitted primitive exactly once.

contract.proof: Idempotent disconnect invalidates the owner, cancels its frame and settlement timer, removes stable listeners, disconnects one observer and subscription, releases renderer resources, clears accessible nodes, removes the overlay, and restores borrowed attributes and styles.
contract.adversarialWitness: Disconnect during a pending frame, wheel settlement, active captured pinch, and lost WebGL context leaves zero connection lifecycle diagnostics and ignores stale callbacks.

fullScan.rationale: Cleanup visits only connection-owned resources and bounded accessible nodes.

resources.listeners: 0 or 1 wheel plus 0 or 4 pointer listeners

contract.proof: The adapter filters the bounded projected axis list, dispatches one Chart-owned domain action per enabled axis, retains at most two pointer positions, and replaces one settlement timer. Controller render commands enter the connection's single-frame coalescer.
contract.adversarialWitness: Two-axis pinch plus an enabled wheel burst at a domain limit performs bounded axis lookups, releases pointer capture, leaves browser defaults uncancelled when unchanged, and retains one timer and frame.

fullScan.rationale: Browser input cannot inspect source datums, layers, or unrelated axes.

variables.name: k
variables.meaning: emitted primitives inspected only while interaction state is visible
variables.ceiling: Chart projection representative ceiling; at most 512 overlay markers emitted

contract.proof: The connection-owned SVG samples each axis to at most 512 ticks, emits at most 64 legend entries and 512 interaction markers, and otherwise retains no datum nodes. Interaction marking scans the already bounded emitted batches only when active, cursor, or selection state is visible.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every axis requests the Core tick maximum and the chart declares more than 64 layers.

fullScan.rationale: Overlay work is bounded by resolved axes, sampled ticks, and legend ceilings rather than source datums.

contract.proof: Each layer owns one geometry buffer and at most one color buffer. Compatible views update uniforms only; changed immutable geometry is converted once and uses a bounded changed-range upload when the calibrated gate admits it.
contract.adversarialWitness: One value changes near each end of a large layer, forcing a full upload, while every unchanged layer retains buffer identity.

fullScan.rationale: A new immutable geometry owner may require one equality-range scan before selecting full versus partial upload; compatible views never inspect its values.

contract.proof: Construction evaluates one selector, retains one record, and inserts it into one form or field Set channel.
contract.adversarialWitness: A subscription to an absent field still allocates one field-channel record and no domain projection.

fullScan.rationale: Subscription construction cannot inspect registered fields or other subscriptions.

variables.name: uSource
variables.meaning: field owners affected by a source-wide issue transition

variables.name: sAffected
variables.ceiling: all connection-owned field subscriptions for reset/reinitialize

variables.name: sField
variables.meaning: all active field subscriptions retained by the connection

contract.proof: Dispatch snapshots the coarse channel and only event-routed field channels; source-wide events reuse Form owner indexes and reset/reinitialize explicitly visit every subscribed field channel.
contract.adversarialWitness: A source replacement touching one of 10k fields evaluates coarse selectors plus only that field's channel, while reset deliberately evaluates every subscribed field channel.

fullScan.rationale: Ordinary single-field updates cannot enumerate unrelated fields or field subscription channels.

contract.proof: The idempotent disposer marks one record inactive, deletes it from one Set, and removes an empty field channel from one Map.
contract.adversarialWitness: Repeated disposal during active dispatch changes no other channel and retains no subscription.

fullScan.rationale: Unsubscribe owns a direct record and channel reference.

contract.proof: Connection discovers the owned ancestor chain once; source-owned WeakMap registries retain one physical listener and only callbacks for connections affected by that source.
contract.adversarialWitness: Deep nested scrolling ancestors with every target connected.

fullScan.rationale: Global documents or unrelated connections must never be scanned.

contract.proof: Cleanup visits each connection-owned disposer once and clears all retained resources.
contract.adversarialWitness: Maximum ancestor registrations followed by repeated idempotent disconnect.

fullScan.rationale: Only the connection-owned disposer vector is visited.

contract.proof: Discovery walks the owned overflow/document ancestor chain once and records each unique source.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every ancestor establishes a distinct clipping or scrolling context.

fullScan.rationale: Initial connection discovery must classify every owned ancestor exactly once.

contract.proof: Generation coalescing retains at most one pending update callback per connection.
contract.adversarialWitness: Many synchronous invalidations before the next frame still retain one scheduled callback.

fullScan.rationale: Scheduling cannot inspect ancestors, candidates, or unrelated connections.

contract.proof: An update consumes retained discovery, completes reference/floating/boundary/ancestor reads, invokes the bounded Core AnchoredLayout solver, then commits one owned projection.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every ancestor clips and every side candidate overflows.

fullScan.rationale: Ordinary updates cannot rediscover ancestors or scan global connections.

contract.proof: One logical pin-order index is built for visible columns, then each canonical header node contributes once to a descendant interval and metric.
contract.adversarialWitness: A deep grouped header tree with hidden leaves and all three pin regions produces exact start and span values without any descendant column lookup scan.

fullScan.rationale: Refreshing header attributes projects the current complete canonical header topology once.

variables.name: n
variables.meaning: previous and native text code-unit count

contract.proof: Reconciliation scans a shared prefix and suffix at most once, emits one Core replace transition, and retains only one active composition record plus one generation-guarded composition finalizer.
contract.adversarialWitness: A 100k-code-unit replacement differing only in the final surrogate pair reconstructs the exact native value within the deterministic two-input-length inspection ceiling; disconnect invalidates the pending finalizer.

fullScan.rationale: Autocomplete, history, and selectionless input types expose the resulting value but not a trustworthy changed range, so exact reconciliation may inspect the complete owned value.
